title: Allow bootstrapped Admin to create the first center from the browser
verify: A bound Admin without center membership opens /admin, creates one server-generated center, and receives the center membership atomically.
An existing member Admin is routed to its own center Admin surface; unauthenticated, non-Admin, repeated, and forged-field requests fail before mutation.
Independent Attempt 2 verification is PASS and semantic-pass after the Attempt 1 forged-field failure and bounded correction.
evidence_required: FT-001-AC-009 Attempt 1 RED: forged centerId/role fields were accepted and mutated state; retained in .tasks/TASK-025-T3-FT-001-W11/ and .protocols/TASK-025-T3-FT-001-W11/.

FT-001-AC-009 Attempt 2 GREEN: /admin accepts exactly one name field, rejects forged/unknown/duplicate fields with 400 before the public command, and leaves center/membership state unchanged; verifier probe, functional PASS, and semantic-pass reports are retained under .tasks/TASK-025-T3-FT-001-W11/.
purpose: Provide the browser entry and one-time center creation path for a manually bootstrapped provider-bound Admin.
success_outcome: A provider-bound Admin without membership can create exactly one center in the protected browser UI, gain its membership atomically, and reach the own-center Admin surface without client-trusted scope.
anti_goals: Do not add first-run onboarding, passwords, development login, or manual center seeding.
Do not trust submitted center, role, account, or membership fields.
Do not add class, schedule, teacher privilege, or participant management beyond the existing center Admin entry.

stop_conditions: Stop if the flow requires direct route persistence, a password/dev-login bypass, or a new unaccepted ownership edge.

constraints: Center & Scheduling owns center and membership writes; routes call only its public boundary.
The server resolves the session actor and Admin scope; browser fields cannot widen authorization.
The center and Admin membership commit together or neither persists.
invariants: Only a provider-bound Admin without center membership can use the bootstrap center command, once.
Successful creation generates the center ID server-side and creates the Admin membership atomically.
Forged, unknown, duplicate, unauthenticated, non-Admin, and repeated requests fail before mutation.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-009: isolated browser/HTTP flow for bootstrap success, atomic rollback, once-only denial, member Admin routing, and no-mutation forged/non-Admin/unauthenticated denial.
.memory-bank/contracts/authentication-transport.md#bootstrap-admin-and-center-creation: protected entry and callback routing preserve server-owned identity and scope.
.memory-bank/contracts/access-control.md#authority-and-scope: no client-provided role, center, or membership is trusted.
.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#account-provisioning-boundary: route delegates to the accepted public owner boundary without direct persistence.
